quote: The plant stayed on. The workers were meant to leave. Find the line that changed before you ask me to put my name under yours.

quote: You have made one column answer for another. Look again. I am not asking you to believe me; I am asking you to read what is there.

quote: Keep the question beside the answer you actually brought back. I still have to work here tomorrow.
